:::{#thm-distributive}
#### Distributive laws for propositions

For [propositions](#def-proposition) $A$, $B$ and $C$:

$$
\ba
A \land (B \lor C) &\equiv (A \land B) \lor (A \land C) \\
A \lor (B \land C) &\equiv (A \lor B) \land (A \lor C)
\ea
$$

:::

::: {.content-hidden when-format="revealjs"}

::: proof

By the definitions of [and](#def-and) and [or](#def-or),
the [truth table](#def-truth-table) for the first law is:

| $A$ | $B$ | $C$ | $A \land (B \lor C)$ | $(A \land B) \lor (A \land C)$ |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| T | T | T | T | T |
| T | T | F | T | T |
| T | F | T | T | T |
| T | F | F | F | F |
| F | T | T | F | F |
| F | T | F | F | F |
| F | F | T | F | F |
| F | F | F | F | F |

and for the second law:

| $A$ | $B$ | $C$ | $A \lor (B \land C)$ | $(A \lor B) \land (A \lor C)$ |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| T | T | T | T | T |
| T | T | F | T | T |
| T | F | T | T | T |
| T | F | F | T | T |
| F | T | T | T | T |
| F | T | F | F | F |
| F | F | T | F | F |
| F | F | F | F | F |

In each table the last two columns match in every row,
so each law is a [logical equivalence](#def-logically-equivalent).

:::

:::
